mapper.select: SELECT info.id, info.order_no, info.start_location, info.end_location, if(info.status < 7, info.expect_amount, bill.pay_amount) as amount, info.status, info.create_time FROM order_info info left join order_bill bill on info.id = bill.order_id WHERE info.customer_id = #{customerId} AND info.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY info.create_time DESC

SELECT info.id, info.order_no, info.start_location, info.end_location, real_amount as pay_amount, if(info.status < 7, info.expect_amount, info.real_amount) as amount, info.status, info.create_time FORM order_info info WHERE info.driver_id = #{driverId} AND info.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY info.create_time DESC
